title: WinUI Gallery catalog scenario source
description: The XAML and C# shown for each scenario listed in catalog/windows-samples.json, published alongside it so a consumer can retrieve every snippet in one request instead of one request per file. Generated by tools/CatalogExporter in the same pass as the manifest. Kept in a separate file because the manifest is metadata that gets imported into the federated windows-samples catalog, which carries no source. See catalog/README.md.

$schema.description: Relative path back to this schema file.

schemaVersion.description: Version of this file's contract, bumped only for a breaking change to the shape below. Versioned independently of windows-samples.json.

command.description: Command used to regenerate this file. Regenerates the manifest at the same time.

manifest.description: Relative path to the manifest whose scenario ids this file is keyed by.

scenarioCount.description: Number of entries in 'scenarios'. Kept alongside the array for cheap consumer-side sanity checks.

scenarios.description: One entry per scenario that has source, sorted by id. Scenarios whose page hides the code viewer, or whose code still comes from the legacy ControlExample.XamlSource/CSharpSource properties, appear in the manifest but are absent here.

source.description: Repository-relative path to the snippet bundle this content was parsed from, rooted at the repository root.

xaml.description: Contents of the bundle's '--- xaml' section, verbatim. Absent when the scenario shows no XAML. May contain $(Token) placeholders bound by the page's ControlExample.Substitutions.

code.description: Contents of the bundle's '--- c#' section, verbatim. Absent when the scenario shows no C#.
